description: This file defines the DrawableBuilder class, which is responsible for constructing Drawable objects based on theme and resource ID, primarily used for UI rendering in the keyboard view.

classes.name: DrawableBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating Drawable objects based on theme and resource ID.

methods.name: buildDrawable
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Drawable object if not already created, using the theme's package context and resource ID.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a DrawableBuilder instance from a theme, TypedArray, and index, extracting the resource ID.
